items.statement: The charge calculation is tied to a converged neutral singlet geometry and the submitted validation reports whether the geometry is stationary.
items.expected: A reproducible calculation identifies charge 0, multiplicity 1, convergence, and a stationary-point check or an honestly documented failure.

items.statement: The two charge sites are chemically and numerically mapped rather than identified only by an undefined label.
items.expected: The report gives XYZ indices and chemical descriptions for the amidine imine carbon A and hydrazone imine carbon B.

items.statement: NPA charges are extracted for the two specified imine carbons.
items.expected: A and B are reported as quantitative NPA charges in |e| with provenance.

items.statement: The amidine imine carbon is more positively charged than the hydrazone imine carbon.
items.expected: The report states A > B and computes their difference.
